name: LinkedRecordRef
title: Linked record reference
description: A pedigree person's link to a record in the host application, on their Patient in a GA4GH pedigree, as an opaque string the host's record-link provider understands. redcap_pedigree_editor writes `record:<record id>/instance:<n>`, a row of a repeating instrument.
